title: Angular Quiz
description: Review the ideas from the lessons. Take your time. After each answer, read the note that explains the rule. You can try again.

questions.question: What does Angular help you build?
questions.explanation: Angular helps you build a web app. For example, it can show a new score when you press a button.
options: Web pages with parts that can change
A computer screen made of glass

questions.question: Fill the gap: ng generate ___ greeting makes a new page part.
questions.explanation: A component is one part of a page. The CLI can make its starting files for you.

questions.question: Which template code listens for a button click?
questions.explanation: Round brackets listen for an event. Angular calls save() when the user clicks.

questions.question: Why does an @for loop use track item.id?
questions.explanation: A stable id works like a name tag. Angular can find the same item when the list changes.
options: To tell the same item apart from other items

questions.question: What text appears when ready is false?
questions.explanation: The @else part is shown when the condition is false.

questions.question: What number is printed? Run this inside an Angular project.
questions.explanation: count becomes 3. The computed value multiplies the current count by 2.

questions.question: What must a parent give a child with input.required<string>()?
questions.explanation: A required input needs a value from the parent. Angular checks that the parent supplies it.
options: A text value for that input

questions.question: A root service can share the same basket data between two page parts.
questions.explanation: A root service has one shared instance in the app. Two components can use that same basket.

questions.question: What does loadComponent help a route do?
questions.explanation: Lazy loading waits until a page is needed before loading its code. This can reduce the first download.
options: Load a page component when it is needed

questions.question: To use [formControl] in a template, import ___ in the component.
questions.explanation: ReactiveFormsModule supplies the formControl template directive. Import it before using that binding.

questions.question: What should a page show while it waits for data?
questions.explanation: Loading, success and error are different states. A loading message explains why the answer is not ready yet.

questions.question: A pipe class has a ___ method that changes a value for display.
questions.explanation: Angular calls transform with the input value. The returned value is shown in the template.

questions.question: What can @defer (on viewport) do?
questions.explanation: The viewport is the visible part of the page. This rule waits until the part is about to be seen.
options: Wait to load a part until it comes into view

questions.question: How can a component test set an input named name?
questions.explanation: setInput sets the component input through Angular. After the view updates, the test can check the displayed name.

questions.question: For an Angular app with client routes, what should a static host serve for an app URL with no file?
questions.explanation: The host sends the app page. Then the Angular router reads the URL and shows the right component.
